Class ClientCallExtractor

java.lang.Object
com.macstab.chaos.jvm.instrumentation.ClientCallExtractor
public final class ClientCallExtractor extends Object
Reads the attributes client-library hooks report (topic, gRPC method, Redis command, AWS service and operation, Netty peer) reflectively, so the agent has no compile-time dependency on any of those libraries. Every reader returns null when the value cannot be read; callers wrap the reads in BootstrapDispatcher.beginInternalCall()/endInternalCall() so the agent's own reflection is not evaluated as application reflection.

Public because the advice that calls it is inlined into the library classes, which live in other packages; a package-private class there fails with IllegalAccessError. Part of the bootstrap bridge (BridgeInjector.BRIDGE_CLASSES): the library classes resolve it through the bootstrap class loader, so a library defined by a loader that cannot see the agent's (one whose parent is the platform loader) still links. Like every bridge class it references no agent class outside the bridge.

    • grpcRetries

      public static boolean grpcRetries(Object provider)
      Whether provider is a managed channel's stream provider with retries enabled (gRPC's default) whose gRPC has the per-attempt hook: it opens a RetriableStream, whose attempts the retry policy repeats. A reject is then evaluated per attempt ( GrpcNewSubstream), so the policy sees a rejected attempt as it sees a real UNAVAILABLE; without that hook it is evaluated for the call.
      Parameters:
      provider - the ClientStreamProvider
      Returns:
      true when the call's attempts are evaluated instead of the call

    • grpcFailingStream

      public static @Nullable Object grpcFailingStream(Throwable rejected)
      Builds the stream gRPC itself returns for a call that fails before it reaches a transport: an io.grpc.internal.FailingClientStream for the status of rejected (a StatusRuntimeException), through the class loader of that status. The call then fails through its listener with that status, as a deadline that expired before the call started does, also when the stream is created later inside the channel's synchronization context (a call started before the name resolved), where a throw would panic the channel.
      Parameters:
      rejected - the library exception the reject built
      Returns:
      the failing stream, or null when rejected carries no gRPC status or this gRPC version has no known FailingClientStream constructor (recorded once, see failingStreamMiss())

    • nettyDatagramChannel

      public static boolean nettyDatagramChannel(Object channel)
      Returns whether channel is a Netty datagram channel. Its doWrite is not evaluated: a real write error there fails one datagram and the channel stays open, but a throw from the hook would close the channel (AbstractUnsafe.handleWriteError).
      Parameters:
      channel - the channel
      Returns:
      true for a DatagramChannel or DomainDatagramChannel
